subject: Project Sirocco kickoff - training to the metric that actually ships
body:
Team,

Kicking off what we're calling Project Sirocco internally - our trust-theory effort built on the Implicit Constrained Optimization (ICO) release. The problem it attacks: production classifiers are judged on rate metrics with a thresholded form - false negative rate at a fixed false positive rate, precision at fixed recall, AUC-PR - but trained on proxies. ICO's trick is expressing the threshold as a function of the model parameters via the implicit function theorem, so you can optimize the deployed metric directly, constraint and all.

Scope for Sirocco: reproduce the FNR-at-fixed-FPR results on the CelebA attribute tasks, then evaluate on two internal screening classifiers where the FPR budget is contractual.

Milestones: CelebA repro by mid-March, internal-classifier evaluation through April, recommendation memo by 2026-05-25.

Fumiko owns methodology, Wanjiru implementation, Nikhil experiments. Ivo - staffing and compute note please. Use the Sirocco tag on docs so things stay findable.

Ximena
